data_fields.name: rent_items_required
data_fields.donor_constant: per house from the slumlord create list (no number in code)

best_idea: Keep every owned plot in a due-time queue, settle each entry once when it falls due (paid, grace or evict), and always re-queue a paid or graced entry so no owner silently drops out.
decision_why: Take the due queue, settle-at-due and the hook budget as a display cap, but charge upkeep from the one ledger (no slumlord inbox, no server-made payments), add a grace window for unpaid rent (ruling needed), and never remove storage without a ledger row per item.
acceptance: A server test shows an unpaid plot enters grace at its due time, is evicted only after the grace window, a paid plot gets its next due date and is re-queued, a lookup failure does not evict, and no item is removed without a ledger row listing it first.
